commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
90+2' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) sends the free kick into the box, but Alvaro Valles leaps to intercept it.
90+1' Angel Ortiz (Betis) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' That's the end of the game for Cedric Bakambu, who is replaced by Nelson Deossa (Betis).

86' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
84' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

84' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
83' The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.

83' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Leo Roman produces a good save. Now Betis have a corner.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Toni Lato (Mallorca) replaces Johan Mojica.
81' The attendance is 18658.

80' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
80' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
80' Antony (Betis) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Leo Roman anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
78' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) replacing Samu Costa.
78' It is time for a substitution. Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is on for Sergi Darder.
77' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

76' That was a nice football moment. Pablo Fornals (Betis) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top left corner. Leo Roman guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
74' Isidro Diaz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pablo Fornals (Betis) and blew his whistle.
74' Angel Ortiz (Betis) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
73' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) launches a cross from the corner, but Alvaro Valles is alert to thwart the effort.

71' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
70' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

66' 1 - 2 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
63' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
61' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

55' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alvaro Valles (Betis) receives a yellow card.

50' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

43' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
43' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

31' This shall not pass! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

29' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
29' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will deliver the corner kick.
29' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' That looked a certain handball by David Lopez (Mallorca) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
27' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
25' A shot from the edge of the box by Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
21' Samu Costa (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
18' Antony (Betis) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Leo Roman makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Llorente (Betis) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) dribbles into the box, but Alvaro Valles is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
13' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and David Lopez (Mallorca) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
13' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner.
12' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' A pass into the penalty area from Jan Virgili (Mallorca) is intercepted by the defence. Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
11' Pablo Fornals (Betis) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
7' Isidro Diaz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Samu Costa (Mallorca).

4' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Alvaro Valles and his nice save.
3' Marc Roca (Betis) fires a brilliant shot in from 32 metres out, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
1' Samu Costa (Mallorca) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
